# Class `puc::execution_graph::DependencyGraph`

Store and validate a reusable directed dependency graph.

An edge from `prerequisite` to `dependent` means the prerequisite must complete first. Validation produces deterministic forward layers in stable node-registration order. Reversing those layers yields a teardown order in which every dependent precedes all of its prerequisites.

Construction, validation, snapshots, and layer queries are thread-safe. Successful validation is cached until another node or edge is added.
